newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to tender 150,000 T barley on April 29.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to tender 150,000 T barley on April 29.

text.p: Turkey's state grain board (TMO) will seek bids for an international tender on April 29 to export 100,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley, a senior TMO official said on Monday.
"We will issue a notification for a tender to be held on April 29. It will be for exports of 100,000 tonnes of feed and 50,000 tonnnes of malting barley," said Ismet Agan, the TMO's general manager.
"We will retain the remaining amount of some 150,000 tonnes for emergency stocks," he told Reuters.
He did not give any other details.
The TMO cancelled a tender in February to sell 150,000 tonnes feed barley and 50,000 tonnes malting barley because of unsatisfactory prices. It holds about 300,000 tonnes in its total barley stocks.
Feed barley prices in the local Turkish market are about $140 per tonne, compared to FOB export prices on international markets of about $134.
